quote.text: -Who are those people by whom you wish to be admired? Are they not these whom you are in the habit of saying that they are mad? What then? Do you wish to be admired by the mad?
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Reflect on the role models you present to your children—choose those who embody wisdom and reason rather than erratic impulses, ensuring that your influence nurtures sound judgment.
    • Encourage your children to critically assess who they admire; impart the lesson that admiration should be reserved for those whose actions reflect thoughtful virtue rather than mere spectacle.
  • Leadership
    • In leadership, be mindful of the examples you set; strive to emulate individuals whose calm deliberation and clear purpose inspire trust and stability among your followers.
    • Recognize that healthy leadership avoids idolizing the unstable or the irrational—instead, foster an environment that values measured actions and principled decision-making.
  • Product Management
    • Apply critical discernment when choosing project inspirations or team influences—ensure that the ideals motivating your product align with logic, evidence, and sustainable values rather than fleeting trends.
    • Build product strategies based on rational insights and thoughtful analysis, avoiding the pitfalls of chasing after ideas that may seem exciting but lack solid grounding in reality.
